patch_description: The previous iteration was over-filtering, resulting in significantly fewer trades than the high-performing seed model. This modification lowers the entry threshold from 0.002 to 0.0018 and relaxes microstructure filters (OBI, VWAP deviation, and spread) to capture more high-conviction signals. It also increases the base position size to 0.13 and introduces a conditional hold-time extension for the US session when trend strength is significant, aiming to improve total return and Sharpe while leveraging the high observed win rate.
